name: Engineering Calculation Specialist Adapter — Math Service

parameters.content:
## Calculation Adapter — n8n 2.30.8

Accepts `specialist_packet/v1.0`, every attached `.dev` binary and one ASCII CPS3 surface. Edit the local Math Service URL in the visible configuration node, then bind this workflow in the Orchestrator's `Call Calculation Specialist` node.

All DEV files are sent in one multipart request as repeated `trajectory_files` fields. The Math Service parses the surface once, performs bilinear interpolation and returns one first-in-MD intersection per source filename.

The portable UI-only adapter reserves 256 multipart trajectory slots because n8n 2.30.8 does not evaluate a dynamic fixedCollection array in HTTP Request. Empty slots use tiny reserved sentinel uploads ignored by Math Service; occupied slots are repeated `trajectory_files`.
